digest.component_or_area: live Jira Cloud S3 integration test suite
propositions: A read-only, S3-backed live test suite for Jira Cloud multi-project reconciliation over projects REB and DIG is missing, leaving the S3 store backend and real Cloud ticket volume/diversity uncovered by tests.

The new suite must structurally enforce read-only semantics by monkeypatching all mutating AcliClient methods (create_issue, update_issue, add_comment, add_label, etc.) to raise JiraWriteForbidden, and use only compute_snapshot and bridge_preview in dry-run mode.

Per-project Jira issue counts must remain identical before and after each live scenario to prove zero mutations occur against Cloud, and unknown project keys must fail closed with an exception rather than silently succeeding.
The isolated test store must use a fresh, throwaway S3 prefix as its sole remote (via git-remote-s3 with REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off) and be deleted in teardown to prevent any production reachability.
